notes.title: Mobile version + 11 languages + 32 new songs!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637782/76b1593c91f941d189e6bf0265e90fc5a8acca01.png"]

+  ERAIASON is now available on mobile platforms.  Android version is available now on itch.io, coming soon to Google Play Store and iOS.

+ You can now select from 11 languages.  The full list of available languages is:

English

Arabic

Chinese

French

German

Hebrew

Hindi

Japanese

Norwegian

Russian

Serbian

+ Added 32 new songs

+ Add option to enable/disable Novelty Search algorithm (which can be computationally expensive and cause lag).
